paths.description: Homepage/catalog entry, including desktop/mobile, preference emulation, privacy/security, network, performance, accessibility and memory evidence.
Latest-updates listing template, representing paginated video indexes.
Category listing template at a narrow viewport, representing taxonomy indexes.
Primary search journey with a real query and populated results.
Representative video detail/player template and its legal age-verification play gate.
Unknown route to inspect the HTTP 404 and recovery experience.

findings.summary: System dark preference is ignored.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark, computed body background remained rgb(255,255,255), color-scheme was normal, and the stylesheet capability probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and provide preference-driven surface, text, border, and control colors using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route changes have no transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The stylesheet probe found no view-transition rules and the site is a server-rendered MPA whose navigation changes state abruptly.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a progressively enhanced @view-transition rule for cross-document navigation and preserve a no-motion path.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide no scroll-state-aware orientation.
findings.evidence: Mobile evidence shows an 8,808px document, while CSS inspection found no scroll-state query, progress affordance, or scroll-position-aware styling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight scroll progress or a state-aware sticky header that reduces chrome while preserving location context.

findings.summary: Dropdown and overlay positioning is hand-rolled rather than anchored.
findings.evidence: The navigation contains custom dropdown triggers and the CSS capability probe found no anchor positioning or top-layer semantic primitive use.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for menus that need edge-aware attachment.

findings.summary: Sign-up is injected as a custom Fancybox-style overlay instead of a semantic dialog.
findings.evidence: After activating Sign Up, the DOM contained a third injected form but zero dialog and zero popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Render account flows in a dialog element, use showModal(), label the dialog, trap focus through the platform, and support Escape/close actions.

findings.summary: Reusable grids adapt only at viewport level.
findings.evidence: The responsive page works at 360px, but the live DOM had zero non-normal containers and the stylesheet had zero @container rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reused card/list components containment and use size container queries so they adapt in sidebars, full-width grids, and embedded contexts.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and small targets are not consistently usable.
findings.evidence: The first focused interactive element computed outline:none; Lighthouse found target-size failures, including 15-16px-high category/model links.
findings.suggestedFix: Add visible :focus-visible styles and increase interactive hit areas/spacing to at least the platform target-size floor.

findings.summary: The 404 state is a dead end.
findings.evidence: A nonexistent route returns a bare nginx 404 with no site navigation, search, home link, explanation, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 template with search, home and category links, preserve global navigation, and clearly explain what happened.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 5.0s (score 0.27), while the controlled desktop trace was faster at 1.08s, showing a material mobile-path regression.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the mobile LCP image, reduce pre-LCP analytics/script contention, and verify LCP below 2.5s on representative mobile conditions.

findings.summary: The LCP image is not priority hinted and resource delivery is analytics-heavy.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported the LCP resource was discoverable and eager but lacked fetchpriority=high; HAR recorded 494KB of script transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Set fetchpriority=high on the known LCP image, keep it eager, and delay non-critical analytics until after the primary content becomes usable.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused JS and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 235KiB unused JavaScript across GTM, gtag, Yandex and the site bundle, plus 21KiB/83.7% unused stylesheet bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics loaders, load route-specific code/styles, and defer optional third-party scripts behind an explicit need or consent.

findings.summary: Core form and player controls lack robust accessible names.
findings.evidence: Search and sign-up probes found inputs with zero associated labels and no aria-label; the apparent player control is a span inside a link whose only image alt is “preview”.
findings.suggestedFix: Add persistent label elements, meaningful button/link names, correct roles, and an accessible name/state for the age-gated play action.

findings.summary: Secondary text fails WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured date metadata at 1.94:1 and age-verification subtext at 3.74:1, below the 4.5:1 text requirement.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken secondary text and verification copy while preserving hierarchy, then re-run contrast checks in light and dark themes.

findings.summary: The page has no main landmark and focus indication is missing.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed landmark-one-main, while the direct focus probe reported outline:none on the first focusable element.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main, preserve logical headings, and provide a clearly visible :focus-visible treatment throughout.

findings.summary: Dense mobile metadata is too small and visually weak.
findings.evidence: The mobile screenshot shows 12px low-contrast dates and tightly packed two-column card metadata; Lighthouse confirms repeated contrast failures in those labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase metadata size/line-height, allow comfortable wrapping, and use spacing rather than low contrast alone to create hierarchy.

findings.summary: Touch targets fail the minimum target-size bar.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple category and model links only 15-16px high with insufficient safe spacing, despite successful 360px reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase the clickable boxes and spacing while retaining the overflow-free two-column layout.

findings.summary: Most images omit intrinsic dimensions and modern delivery hints.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 90/100 images without width/height, 60 without srcset, and 96 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width and height, responsive srcset/sizes, and AVIF/WebP alternatives from the image pipeline.

findings.summary: The page is not eligible for back/forward cache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported five BFCache blockers, including main-resource cache-control:no-store and WebSocket usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid unconditional no-store and open long-lived connections only where needed; retest navigation restoration in DevTools.

findings.summary: Several navigation/account actions are not crawlable links.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found five non-crawlable anchors, including Sign Up/Login with data-href only and an Our Network javascript:void(0) trigger.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations for navigation and buttons for actions; keep progressive enhancement for AJAX overlays.

findings.summary: robots.txt points at the wrong sitemap host.
findings.evidence: The live robots.txt declares https://zbporn.com/sitemap.xml while the audited host serves its sitemap index at https://zbporn.tv/sitemap.xml.
findings.suggestedFix: Update the Sitemap directive to the canonical .tv sitemap and verify host/canonical consistency across localized variants.

findings.summary: Video detail pages lack VideoObject structured data.
findings.evidence: The detail page has useful Open Graph video metadata but zero JSON-LD blocks and no Twitter metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD and complete social-card metadata that mirrors the visible title, description, thumbnail, duration and publication date.

findings.summary: Session/cookie and XSS defenses are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP and nosniff are missing; 11 cookies were reported insecure and PHPSESSID was not HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a nonce/hash-based CSP and nosniff; mark all HTTPS cookies Secure, set appropriate SameSite values, and make the session cookie HttpOnly.

findings.summary: Tracking starts before any privacy choice.
findings.evidence: The initial load contacted Google Analytics/GTM and Yandex; HAR attributed about 400KB of script to those services and the tracker probe found five third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not load non-essential analytics before consent; minimise vendors/events, shorten identifiers, batch essential metrics, and document the resulting data flow.

findings.summary: Account creation is password-only with no modern authentication path.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse confirms no permission prompts on load, but the sign-up overlay exposes two password fields and no WebAuthn/passkey affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/authentication and retain a clear fallback and recovery path.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no CSP/frame-ancestors policy, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; X-Frame-Options and HSTS are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a staged CSP, explicit Referrer-Policy and restrictive Permissions-Policy, retaining frame protection and HSTS.

findings.summary: The multilingual layout remains heavily dependent on physical CSS properties.
findings.evidence: The page declares lang=en and 12 hreflang links, but stylesheet analysis counted 234 physical left/right properties versus 55 logical-property tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace directional margin/padding/position declarations with inline/block logical properties and test an RTL locale.

findings.summary: The privacy reassurance conflicts with observed tracking.
findings.evidence: The prominent banner says “we don’t store personal data,” yet the initial page sets long-lived GA/Yandex identifiers and sends analytics requests before verification or consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Use precise, qualified language that matches actual processing; gate optional tracking and link the reassurance directly to a concise privacy explanation.

findings.summary: The sign-up form provides no declarative validation or accessible error contract.
findings.evidence: Its visible username, email and two password controls have no required attributes, associated labels or aria descriptors in the injected DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Use correct input types and required constraints, validate after interaction, associate inline messages, and announce a summary through an aria-live region.

findings.summary: Account and search fields disable or omit autofill metadata.
findings.evidence: Search uses autocomplete=off; sign-up username, email and password fields expose empty autocomplete values rather than username, email, new-password and current-password tokens.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply purpose-specific autocomplete tokens and correct input types; do not disable useful browser assistance on search or account fields.

findings.summary: The image pipeline is dominated by legacy, non-responsive assets.
findings.evidence: The home image audit found 96 legacy-format images, 60 missing srcset, and 90 missing dimensions; detail pages show the same pattern.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate modern responsive variants, emit srcset/sizes and intrinsic dimensions, and retain lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Multiple analytics stacks perform redundant background work.
findings.evidence: The HAR loads gtag, GTM, Google Analytics and Yandex, while Lighthouse estimates 235KiB unused JavaScript across these stacks.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate telemetry, defer it until needed/allowed, batch events, and stop background work when the page is hidden.

findings.summary: Third-party telemetry consumes a disproportionate share of the initial budget.
findings.evidence: GTM/gtag/Yandex/Google Analytics scripts account for roughly 400KB, while the full initial transfer is 872KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, remove overlapping trackers, and lazy-load optional vendors only after user intent.

findings.summary: HTTP failure states are not integrated with the product experience.
findings.evidence: The verified 404 response is a blank nginx template with no recovery options, preserving neither navigation nor user context.
findings.suggestedFix: Route HTTP errors through resilient application templates with status-specific copy, retry/search/home actions and preserved navigation.

taskList.title: Gate and minimise analytics, then correct the privacy claim
Fix labels, landmarks, focus, contrast and touch targets
Improve mobile LCP and remove unused delivery cost
Replace custom account overlays with semantic, assisted forms
Repair crawlability, sitemap host and video structured data
Progressively enhance navigation and component responsiveness
Use logical properties for localized layouts
